data.fullDescription: Helping established software organizations bridge the gap between AI hype and real engineering leverage. We work alongside senior architects, technical PMs, and leadership to modernize workflows, foster bottom-up innovation, and execute capital-efficient frontier model strategies (Claude, Gemini)—without costly custom-model distractions.
